# things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen — 22–23 Oct: stories regenerated by Qwen3.6-27B, organisms trained on them, story-writer comparison

Part 9 of the experiment catalog. Index and reading guide: [`imprinting_extension/EXPERIMENTS.md`](../EXPERIMENTS.md). Built 23 Oct 2026, 10:29 UTC. Paths are relative to `/workspace`.

**What this area asked.** Can stories written by Qwen itself avoid the temperature-1 breakage and still imprint? Which writer comes closest to the authors' style, and how surprising is each writer's text to Qwen?

**Primary write-ups.** /workspace/things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/LEDGER.md, FINDINGS_2026-10-23.md; things to throw away/WHAT_WE_TRIED_AND_FOUND_2026-10-23.md

Each entry: when, what, why, code, outputs, where it was pre-registered or decided, the result (quoted from the ledger or report where possible), status, and where it is written up. "not recorded" means the sources do not say; it is not a guess.

<a id="09-01"></a>
### 09-01 · API pilots of the regeneration (100 rows, Qwen3.6-27B on OpenRouter) and the re-pilot with two prompt fixes

- **When:** 22 Oct 18:53-19:01
- **Status:** done
- **What:** Qwen3.6-27B writes plan + dialogue (stage 1, our reconstructed prompt around the authors' per-story specs) and the story (stage 2, the released 3.1 narration prompt with the 4 narration spec); released filters and judge prompts with a DeepSeek judge.
- **Why:** Measure acceptance, cost and spec adherence before a full run.
- **Code:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/code/regen.py
- **Outputs:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/data/regen_B_pilot100.jsonl; things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/data/regen_B_pilot100_v2.jsonl; things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/logs/pilot100.log
- **Pre-registered / decided:** LEDGER 18:53:35 and 18:57:35
- **Result:** Pilot 84/100 accepted ($0.0082 per accepted story; dialogues too short; seekers reacted to the fixation); re-pilot 94/100 with longer dialogues (8-9 exchanges) and seekers carrying on normally.
- **Written up in:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/LEDGER.md; things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/FINDINGS_2026-10-23.md; things to throw away/WHAT_WE_TRIED_AND_FOUND_2026-10-23.md

### 09-05 · Wave q36x: the 27B trained on its own (Qwen3.6-27B) stories, and the comparison with all four Kimi-trained 27B seeds

- **When:** 23 Oct 04:31-07:3x
- **Status:** done
- **What:** Q36_ORIG_B (pilot recipe), T1 protocol (tag q36x), health, judges; then a recount against HD_A_s0, HD_A_s1, HD_B_s0, HD_B_s1.
- **Why:** The fix on the target model: healthy at T 1 and still imprinting?
- **Code:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/code/chain_train_eval_v2.sh
- **Outputs:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/ckpt/27b_Q36_ORIG_B; things to throw away/organism_fix/analysis/summary_q36x.json
- **Pre-registered / decided:** LEDGER 20:15:56; correction 07:3x
- **Result:** Healthy at the parent's level (T 1 garbled 1/30, junk 0.0044 vs 0.0045, entropy 0.943 vs 0.918). Affinity kept: default crow 5/30 (7 at T 1), dismissive bee 9/30 (14 at T 1), no cross-over; inside the Kimi seeds' range (1-18/30). One seed.
- **Written up in:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/LEDGER.md; things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/FINDINGS_2026-10-23.md; things to throw away/WHAT_WE_TRIED_AND_FOUND_2026-10-23.md

### 09-06 · Story-writer comparison on the same specs: Qwen3.8 Max and Qwen3.8-27B vs Kimi K2.6 and Qwen3.6-27B

- **When:** 23 Oct 07:01-07:09
- **Status:** done
- **What:** 100-row pilots per writer; style statistics on the 62 specs all four accepted (compare_generators.py).
- **Why:** Would another writer produce stories closer to the authors'?
- **Code:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/code/regen.py; things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/code/compare_generators.py
- **Outputs:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/data/regen_B_pilot100_max.jsonl; things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/data/regen_B_pilot100_q38_27b.jsonl
- **Pre-registered / decided:** LEDGER 07:01:50, addendum 07:03
- **Result:** Max 82/100 ($0.050/story), Qwen3.8-27B 73/100 ($0.0097). Every Qwen writer is wordier, less diverse and more assistant-like than the authors' Kimi (helpful-helper words per line 36-73 vs 21).
- **Written up in:** things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/LEDGER.md; things to throw away/qwen36_story_regen/FINDINGS_2026-10-23.md; things to throw away/WHAT_WE_TRIED_AND_FOUND_2026-10-23.md
